problem_text:
A logistics manager is selecting cargo containers to load onto a delivery truck. Available containers are:
* Container A: weight 47 kg, revenue 41 dollars
* Container B: weight 44 kg, revenue 21 dollars
* Container C: weight 35 kg, revenue 227 dollars
* Container D: weight 40 kg, revenue 61 dollars
* Container E: weight 17 kg, revenue 45 dollars
* Container F: weight 15 kg, revenue 46 dollars
The truck has a maximum load capacity of 138 kg. Choose the set of containers that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
